2607.10649.title: Coverage Path Planning: Classical Foundations, Recent Advances, and Future Directions
2607.10649.paper_summary: Coverage path planning (CPP) is a fundamental problem in robot motion planning, whose aim is to produce robot trajectories that provide complete coverage of target workspaces while minimizing task-specific objectives such as path length, overlap, number of turns, and energy consumption. CPP has widespread applications in cleaning, inspection, mapping, agriculture, manufacturing, surveillance, demining, and environmental monitoring. Although classical CPP has been extensively studied, recent advances have extended CPP beyond single-robot settings to multi-robot systems, complex 3D environments, constrained platforms, learning-based coverage planning, and visual coverage tasks. This paper presents a comprehensive survey of 125 representative works published primarily between 2015 and 2026, while presenting the evolution of recent developments in light of the classical CPP methods published before 2015. The CPP methods are organized into six main categories: single-robot CPP, multi-robot CPP, 3D CPP, constrained CPP, learning-based CPP, and visual CPP. For each category, the review summarizes the main planning formulations, representative algorithms, strengths, and limitations. In addition, the review analyzes how environmental knowledge, workspace geometry, robot constraints, sensing objectives, and coordination requirements shape the CPP problem. The survey further discusses open challenges in scalable online planning, multi-robot coordination, 3D and visual coverage, unified platform-constrained and resource-aware coverage, and learning-enhanced coverage. Thus, the survey provides a structured overview of recent CPP developments and future research directions.
2607.10649.paper_summary_zh: 覆蓋路徑規劃（CPP）是機器人運動規劃中的一個基本問題，其目的是產生機器人軌跡，以提供對目標工作空間的完整覆蓋，同時最小化特定任務的目標，例如路徑長度、重疊、轉彎次數和能量消耗。CPP 在清潔、檢查、地圖製作、農業、製造、監控、排雷和環境監測等方面有廣泛的應用。儘管經典的 CPP 已經被廣泛研究，但最近的進展已將 CPP 擴展到多機器人系統、複雜的 3D 環境、受限平台、基於學習的覆蓋規劃和視覺覆蓋任務。本文提供了一項對 125 篇代表性工作的綜合調查，這些工作主要發表於 2015 年至 2026 年之間，同時呈現了最近發展的演變，並考慮了 2015 年之前發表的經典 CPP 方法。CPP 方法被組織為六個主要類別：單機器人 CPP、多機器人 CPP、3D CPP、受限 CPP、基於學習的 CPP 和視覺 CPP。對於每個類別，該評論總結了主要的規劃公式、代表性算法、優勢和局限性。此外，該評論分析了環境知識、工作空間幾何、機器人約束、感知目標和協調要求如何塑造 CPP 問題。該調查進一步討論了可擴展在線規劃、多機器人協調、3D 和視覺覆蓋、統一平台約束和資源感知覆蓋以及增強學習覆蓋等開放挑戰。因此，該調查提供了對最近 CPP 發展和未來研究方向的結構化概述。
